setlist.title: If I Had The World To Give

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **If I Had The World To Give** (5 reviews): Reviewer says it was played live only about three times, and found the performance stunning; Per the Annotated Grateful Dead Lyrics, the band never liked it and played it just three times [7][10][13][14][15]
- **Iko Iko** (2 reviews): Reviewer hears Iko Iko settling into a very nice, bouncy groove; Reviewer calls the Iko Iko a special treat [10][16]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer calls Sugaree a monster version that stands out in an otherwise so-so first set [14]
- **I Need A Miracle** (1 review): The Miracle jam is one of the two highlights of an otherwise sleepy show, per this reviewer [15]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Described as exploratory, comparable to the Eyes of the World [16]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Reviewer hears a groovy, ultra-relaxed version, with Jerry unhurriedly playing jazzy scales up, down and around [16]
- **Drums** (1 review): Two Drums files exist, identical except that one runs a few seconds longer; each is about twelve minutes [9]
- **Space** (1 review): Drums and space includes cosmic vocalizing from Phil, leading onward [18]

## Setlist highlights

- **If I Had The World To Give**: rare: 5 archived performances [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-08-30.145135.sony.ecm270.nak301.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 196 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd78-08-30.aud.wiley.11479.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 163 min; rated 2.91/5 by 11 [3]. Said about its sound: The audience tape picks up conversations with people the taper met, so it suits sentimental listening; the set 2 soundboard sounds better; Red Rocks acoustics are poor for taping, as sound escapes via side rocks and open ends; soundboards are preferred; Reviewer is glad the second set exists as a soundboard and finds it very sweet [8][17]
- **gd78-08-30.set2-sbd.barbella.8038.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 123 min; rated 4.18/5 by 17 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer's earlier copy of the song ran somewhat fast compared with this soundboard; Set 2 soundboard sounds excellent, while set 1 is not of similar quality; Reviewer calls the soundboard squeaky clean [7][9][13]
- **gd1978-08-30.158131.aud-partial.hicks-fong.flac2448**: audience recording; 11 songs; 86 min [6]

## Around the show

- Stagger Lee, I Need A Miracle and If I Had The World To Give were new songs, later on Shakedown Street [10]
- Reviewer says this was the first show after the band recorded Shakedown Street in the studio [18]
- Reviewer finds the band sluggish here, unlike the back-to-back shows at the same venue the previous month [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-08-30.145135.sony.ecm270.nak301.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: 1st Set: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM-270 mics (row 20, seats 73-75)> Sony TC-158SD (Maxell UDXLII) 2nd Set: Mark… [1]. Also: Taper T. Wiley's audience source patches 0:18 into The Other One and 0:12 into Drums [1]
- **gd78-08-30.aud.wiley.11479.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [3]
- **gd78-08-30.set2-sbd.barbella.8038.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: An older circulating tape used this song and the Iko Iko as filler, with the source unclear; Reviewer credits Charlie Miller's work for the quality of this soundboard collection [7][9]
- **gd1978-08-30.158131.aud-partial.hicks-fong.flac2448**: taped by concert recording by John Hicks & Dennis Fong; transferred by Transferred by Andrew F. 09/2022; source: Handheld deck (mono) > MAC > 1st-Gen mix tape [6]. Also: Partial audience tape possibly made on a portable Panasonic, held up at head level; This segment documents the three new songs; the main tape is currently misplaced; A chunk of Eyes of the World comes from the mono source ID-11479 [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead Red Rocks Amphitheater Morrison CO 7/8/78 3 CD CD's | #4595269627](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-red-rocks-amphitheater-4595269627) [20]
